## Three things worth flagging

**Platform is the real budget winner, not the cheapest-looking one.** Zillow displays "total monthly price" for that property, meaning mandatory fees are already baked into the $1,503–$1,598. Placemakr's $1,532 is base rent only — adding required amenity, trash, pest, utility admin and internet fees plus pet rent (~$125–130/mo) pushes it to roughly **$1,655–$1,660, over your $1,600 ceiling**. It's also just 432 sq ft with a 14-month max lease. I kept it in the top 3 for the location and dog policy, but you should ask for the all-in number before touring.

**Korina at the Grove looked like the bargain of the search and isn't one.** Its $1,196 one-bedroom is an income-restricted "60% MFI" unit requiring qualification; market-rate 1BRs there start at $1,754. I moved it to a conditional runner-up rather than burying that in the fine print.

**The 15-minute drive is an approximation.** I constrained each search geographically (Craigslist to a 5-mile radius of 78701) rather than measuring door-to-door times, so verify against your actual commute. Also, the Craigslist duplex is the only private-landlord listing — Austin has a lot of rental scams, so tour in person before sending money.
